description: This is a Python source file defining FastAPI route handlers for health check endpoints and related utilities for a proxy server in a machine learning or LLM deployment environment. It includes endpoints for liveness, readiness, service health, health history, and model connection testing, along with internal functions for health status management and environment variable resolution.
